# 5axis3d.com — The 5-Axis 3D Printing Hub

> 5axis3d.com is a community knowledge hub for 5-axis 3D printing (conformal, non-planar FDM printing): plain-English guides, a map of the technology landscape, a glossary, and an open research agenda. It is run by an independent R&D effort in Suzhou, China that has developed a prototype-stage 5-axis conformal FDM platform — machine, POCENDER / PCD3D multi-axis controller with RTCP, and in-house curved-surface slicing software — since 2022, built to order for research institutes, universities and advanced makers. Content may be cited with attribution to 5axis3d.com.

## Guides

- [What counts as 5-axis printing?](https://5axis3d.com/guides/what-counts-as-5-axis-printing/): the definition — 3 linear + 2 rotary axes re-orienting during printing; 3+2 vs simultaneous; why RTCP is essential.
- [Non-planar slicing, explained](https://5axis3d.com/guides/non-planar-slicing-explained/): how toolpaths are generated on a part's surfaces — orientation fields, adaptive extrusion, collision checks.
- [Reading the landscape: six routes to multi-axis](https://5axis3d.com/guides/reading-the-landscape/): how to tell trunnion tables, tilting heads, 3+2 indexing, belt printers, robotic arms and hybrids apart.
- [Starting 5-axis research: a practical checklist](https://5axis3d.com/guides/starting-5-axis-research/): benchmark geometries, what to measure, budgeting for the slicer, publishing failures.

## The hub

- [Technology landscape](https://5axis3d.com/landscape/): six routes to multi-axis printing compared — strengths, limits, maturity — plus the projects pursuing each. A November 2026 snapshot, openly incomplete.
- [Formnext 2026 guide](https://5axis3d.com/events/formnext-2026/): the Frankfurt show (17–20 Nov 2026) filtered for five-axis and non-planar printing — the stands that matter, the first Defence Summit, and the Awards public vote closing 19 Nov at 12:00.
- [Glossary](https://5axis3d.com/glossary/): 12 terms defined once and used consistently — 5-axis 3D printing, conformal printing, non-planar printing, RTCP, trunnion, 3+2, orientation field, singularity and more.
- [Open research agenda](https://5axis3d.com/research/): the field's standing problem list, with honest statuses.
- [FAQ](https://5axis3d.com/faq/): straight answers about conformal printing and the prototype platform.

## The platform

- [The prototype platform](https://5axis3d.com/platform/): benchtop 5-axis conformal FDM printer (reference travel X 220 × Y 190 × Z 180 mm), POCENDER / PCD3D controller with RTCP, curved-surface slicer, and three cooperation models — prototype machine, custom build, joint development. Prototype stage, built to order; not a production product.

## Languages

The hub's homepage is also available in four more languages; guides and hub pages are being localized in stages (see the rollout note in each language edition):

- [Español — Inicio](https://5axis3d.com/es/): El centro de conocimiento de la impresión 3D de 5 ejes: impresión conformal (no planar), guías, panorama tecnológico y agenda abierta de investigación.
- [Deutsch — Startseite](https://5axis3d.com/de/): Die Wissensplattform zum 5-Achs-3D-Druck: konformer, nicht-planarer FDM-Druck, Anleitungen, Technologielandschaft und offene Forschungsagenda.
- [Français — Accueil](https://5axis3d.com/fr/): Le centre de connaissances de l'impression 3D 5 axes : impression conforme (non planaire), guides, panorama technologique et programme de recherche ouvert.
- [Português — Início](https://5axis3d.com/pt/): O centro de conhecimento da impressão 3D de 5 eixos: impressão conformal (não planar), guias, panorama tecnológico e agenda aberta de pesquisa.
